title: First restored subscription can occupy the reserved user source identity
reproduction: Open a fresh Room DB with the default seed queued. Insert two enabled subscriptions and one disabled subscription in restore order before that seed runs.
expected: ID 1 belongs to the user source before the first ordinary write. All three subscriptions remain visible with their restored flags.
observed: Before the fix the first subscription (AdAway Official) received ID 1. Normal source queries exclude this ID; the subscription was hidden rather than necessarily deleted.
fix: Insert the localized canonical user row synchronously within the creation callback. Leave catalog/allowlists deferred. No schema change or existing-row repair.
test_evidence: Focused red: First restored source took ID 1. Green: 2 identity + 25 migration checks on API 34. See deep-signoff/restore-identity.md for build boundary.
